_comment: The league's teams. personality.tempo: 0 patient .. 1 shoots early. personality.aggression: 0 sits off .. 1 tackles everything (more fouls). Crest is a placeholder description until art exists. ground: the home ground's name (Tom, 2026-10-19; presentation only; 'the' lower case unless it starts a sentence).

teams.name: Port Calder Gulls
teams.blurb: The harbour club from Port Calder. Quick and direct, they look to shoot early, backed by a crowd that sings sea-shanties.

teams.name: Wrenhollow Stormcrows
teams.blurb: The cliff-top club from Wrenhollow. They press high and tackle hard all game, which wears down their opponents and themselves.

teams.name: Varenne Royale
teams.blurb: The old aristocrats of the Varenne Basin. Patient and possession-heavy, they keep the ball and wait for the right shot.

teams.name: Lisle Vintners
teams.blurb: The vineyard club from Lisle, in the Varenne Basin. A balanced side: steady on the ball and willing to tackle when it counts.

teams.name: Brassgate Anvils
teams.blurb: The foundry club from walled Brassgate. Physical and loud, they tackle everything and give away plenty of fouls doing it.

teams.name: Skarren Rime
teams.blurb: A mountain club from high in the Kettle Highlands. Quick and direct, they tackle firmly and look for an early shot.

teams.name: Qadira Sunhawks
teams.blurb: The market club from Qadira, in the Sunreach. The league's most attacking side: they shoot early and often, and sit off in defence.

teams.name: Kesh Oasis
teams.blurb: The caravan club from Kesh, on the edge of the red desert. Balanced, sensible and well-run, with no fixed style.
